neighbours.label: 'first' marking the first step of an ordered procedure, where a later step ('then', 'next') is expected
fire: To clean the filter, first switch off the unit, then rinse the mesh.
Healing a friendship often means first admitting what you did wrong.
For the garden bed, first remove the weeds and only then add compost.
When changing a tire you should first loosen the nuts before lifting the car.
To install the app, first download the package, then run the setup file.
Good teachers first find out what students already know, and then build on it.
In this recipe you first brown the onions and afterwards add the rice.
Before signing, first read every page and then ask about anything unclear.
quiet: The filter on this unit is easy to rinse and lasts about a year.
Their friendship lasted for decades despite many arguments.
The garden bed was full of weeds and the soil looked dry.
A flat tire on the highway is a stressful experience for any driver.
The app has a clean design and runs smoothly on older phones.
Good teachers are patient, curious and fond of their students.
This recipe uses brown onions, long-grain rice and a little butter.
The contract was twenty pages long and full of legal terms.

notes: Broad pole (3.9% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Logit effect: the + pole suppresses then/later/subsequently, so the - pole promotes them. Probe: 'first melt the butter, then' read 0.28, 'first listening' 0.22.
